query:
SELECT sl.*, c.name as contestName, c.contestStatus, c.rarityRestriction, c.format, c.entries, c.maxEntries, c.startDate, c.endDate
FROM saved_lineups sl
LEFT JOIN contests c ON sl.contestId = c.id
ORDER BY sl.createdAt DESC;
